result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane roadway with a marked crosswalk but no visible traffic control or pedestrian refuge. The environment is dominated by vehicle traffic with long crossing distances and minimal protection for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without a median refuge.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled crossing
hazards.description: The marked crosswalk lacks signals or stop signs to manage vehicle flow on a high-capacity road.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: RRFB Installation
interventions.description: Add Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians at the uncontrolled crossing.

result.summary: The intersection is controlled by traffic lights but lacks fundamental pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and dedicated pedestrian signals. The wide roadway creates a long, unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians in a mixed-use environment.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to designate where pedestrians should cross, reducing driver awareness and pedestrian predictability.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main intersection in the foreground and background.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The absence of pedestrian-specific signal heads forces walkers to rely on vehicular lights, which may not provide adequate clearance time.
hazards.location_in_image: On the traffic signal poles at the intersection corners.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the multi-lane roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to potential vehicle conflicts.
hazards.location_in_image: The entire width of the roadway crossing the field of view.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install ladder or zebra-style pavement markings to clearly define pedestrian crossing areas.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to reduce crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, curb ramps, and a 'No Turn on Red' restriction. However, the wide roadway and lack of high-visibility crosswalk markings or visible pedestrian signals increase exposure and risk for people crossing.

hazards.name: Wide crossing distance
hazards.description: The multi-lane roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the intersection

hazards.name: Low-visibility crosswalk markings
hazards.description: Dashed line markings are less conspicuous to approaching motorists than high-visibility continental patterns.
hazards.location_in_image: Road surface at the intersection crossing

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade dashed crosswalk lines to continental markings to improve driver awareness and yielding.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve sight lines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian countdown signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

result.summary: This residential intersection lacks fundamental pedestrian safety infrastructure despite the presence of a vehicle traffic signal. There are no marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or pedestrian signals, forcing people to navigate the roadway without dedicated protection or guidance.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path across the street.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The absence of curb ramps at the intersection corners creates a significant barrier for individuals with mobility impairments.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: While a vehicle traffic light is present, there are no pedestrian-specific signals to indicate safe crossing times.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at all crossing points to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to the existing traffic signal infrastructure.
